El checklist de tendencia confirmo cortos en 1h/4h/diario en las dos monedas (antes sin direccion) y el regimen paso de neutral a bajista; el sesgo de la sesion ahora es corto, alineado con el diario.

NQ/ES abrieron el cash flojos (NQ +0.17% en 24h, ES -0.6%); ETH y BTC ahora si acompanan la baja, a diferencia de la corrida anterior cuando ETH estaba plano y desacoplado.

Fondeo invirtio posiciones: ETH paso a shorts-crowded (los cortos pagan), BTC paso a neutral. Cuentas largas de ETH ya pasaron el umbral de alerta (3.17 a 1, el corte es 3 a 1): retail muy cargado de largos, contexto contrario. Miedo extremo se mantiene (11).
FOMC Meeting Minutes a las 19:00 UTC (13:00 CT) sigue en la ventana de riesgo, todavia no llega: nada de GO de 15 min antes a 30 min despues.
Conviccion se mantiene baja en las dos: el piso historico (fondeo, miedo extremo, DVOL y el simbolo mismo bajo 40% acumulado) no lo mueve un update ligero.
en: NY update (8:45am CT), fresh snapshot (~22 min); ETH and BTC feed, regime and trend checklist are fresh too.

ETH and BTC fell since the close: ETH from 1,815.10 to 1,794.21, BTC from 64,631.75 to 64,000.01. The 24h move went from flat to bearish on both (ETH -0.95%, BTC -1.56%): the balance day tilted bearish.
The trend checklist confirmed shorts on 1h/4h/daily on both coins (previously no direction) and the regime flipped from neutral to bearish; the session bias is now short, aligned with the daily.

Neither ceiling short got touched overnight (ETH 1,832.85 to 1,836.00, BTC 65,114.23 to 65,447.00, the overnight high fell short of both). BTC's golden long (64,120.35 to 64,174.20) did get played: swept and reclaimed six times, but the last reclaim (12:10 UTC) gave way and price broke that zone's stop (64,000): zone broken. ETH's demand zone (1,742.32 to 1,751.39) was not touched.
NQ/ES opened the cash session soft (NQ +0.17% on 24h, ES -0.6%); ETH and BTC are now following the move down, unlike the prior run when ETH was flat and decoupled.

Funding flipped sides: ETH turned shorts-crowded (shorts are paying), BTC turned neutral. ETH's long-skewed accounts already cleared the alert threshold (3.17 to 1, the cutoff is 3 to 1): retail is heavily long, contrarian context. Extreme fear holds (11).
FOMC Meeting Minutes at 19:00 UTC (1:00pm CT) is still the risk window ahead, not here yet: no GO from 15 min before to 30 min after.
Conviction stays low on both: the historical floor (funding, extreme fear, DVOL and the symbol itself hitting below 40% accumulated) is not moved by a light update.
